title: 30 Rockefeller Plaza
visualBrief: Complete medium-fi Rockefeller slab, NBC studios and western wing, with six east revolving doors, western triple portal, limestone piers and three observation tiers.

nativeAxes.longitudinal: +X along the mapped building long axis
nativeAxes.origin: Ground-level center of exact-QID mapped footprint frame

sourceFacts.architect: Reinhard & Hofmeister; Corbett, Harrison & MacMurray; Hood & Fouilhoux
sourceFacts.exterior: Shot-sawn Indiana buff limestone with cast aluminum spandrels

appearance.identity: Buff limestone Art Deco slab, narrow eastern profile, broad north/south flanks, successive setbacks, two low connecting wings and three terrace crown.
appearance.scope: Complete medium-fi exterior includes all fourteen mapped parts, slender eastern slab, elevator setbacks, low NBC studios, western wing, three observation levels, lowered Skylift and Beam. Original201315-triangle source recipe remains in Git; reviewed source corrects the main six revolving-door casings and western triple-portal treatment. Door locations and western facade relief are reconstructed, not current surveyed hardware. LPC1985 photos/descriptions inform historic architecture; present owner pages corroborate buff limestone, aluminum spandrels and current rooftop attractions. Individual equipment offsets, intermediate heights, facade bay pitch and tier extents remain reconstructed. District uses canonical window_punched as a generic bay graphic; exact pane ratios/colors differ from street geometry. Small facade ribbing, eyelet perforations and inscriptions are below selected browser error bounds; pointed leaf silhouettes remain. Original master similarly omits tiny eyelets despite legacy camera names. Separate rink/Prometheus, Channel Gardens, neighboring Center buildings, tenant lettering and interiors excluded. Absolute grade and physical-device timings unmeasured.

reconstruction.massing: The exact-QID full ground outline and fourteen individual building parts preserve the eastern tall slab, elevator-bank setbacks, low midblock NBC studios and sixteen-story RCA West block. Rounded map260m height is replaced by the published850ft architectural crown.
reconstruction.facade: Continuous limestone piers with recessed dark spandrels and blue-gray panes. Leaf-tip silhouettes remain; small eyelet perforations and micro ribs omitted within medium-fi scope.
reconstruction.entrance: Three recessed eastern portals now have six revolving-door casings; western triple portal added over mapped70m wing. Relief figures, western relief field and door positions are stylized original reconstruction, not scans.
reconstruction.roof: Three reconstructed observation levels have independent deck slabs, published-height clear glass guards, leaf parapets, connecting exterior steps, paired nautical vent stacks, lowered2024 west Skylift and north69F Beam. Exact equipment offsets and tier extents are photo reconstruction.
